identity_marker: rectangular Trenitalia paper ticket with red and white logo, and a green and white Trenitalia validation machine mounted on a metal pole
continuity_anchors: outdoor train platform environment with natural daylight and blurred train tracks in the background
video_goal: Demonstrate how to properly insert and validate a paper train ticket using a Trenitalia platform machine.
single_prompt: A wide shot captures a person walking up to a green and white Trenitalia validation machine mounted on a metal pole at an outdoor train platform. The camera moves over the shoulder as the person holds up a rectangular Trenitalia paper ticket, displaying the red and white logo and printed journey details. In a close-up, the person's hands rotate the ticket 180 degrees to position the blank, narrow edge at the top. The camera pans down the curved front of the machine to center on the wide, horizontal insertion slot at the bottom. From a first-person view, the hand aligns the top edge of the paper perfectly parallel with the horizontal slot. An extreme close-up shows the edge of the paper ticket sliding into the far-left side of the slot. The hand pushes the ticket deep into the slot, pressing it firmly against the back wall until it stops moving. The paper ticket shifts slightly downward as the internal stamping mechanism physically clamps onto the edge. A small circular LED indicator light on the front of the machine flashes green, signaling the stamping process is complete. The hand pinches the bottom of the ticket and pulls it smoothly and horizontally out of the machine's slot. An extreme close-up reveals a freshly printed black ink timestamp and station code along the margin of the ticket. Finally, from an over-the-shoulder view, the person lowers the validated ticket, tucks it into a wallet, and turns their body toward the train tracks.
